description: Taipei Meowcast 2026 calendar: 24 solar terms, Taiwan public holidays and major Chinese/Western festivals. If multiple observances share a date, the primary event drives artwork and additional observances are stored in also.

2026-01-01.caption_en: New-year goal: less worry, more sleep. I'll demonstrate the sleep part.
2026-01-01.caption_zh: 新年目標：少一點焦慮，多一點睡眠。後半句我先示範。

2026-01-05.caption_en: Minor Cold is on the calendar: another excuse for a cosy lie-in. Let the forecast choose your layers.
2026-01-05.caption_zh: 小寒到了，衣服多一件，賴床的理由也多一個。實際穿多少，記得看預報。

2026-01-20.caption_en: Major Cold has arrived on the calendar. The duvet is now essential infrastructure; check the temperature before dressing.
2026-01-20.caption_zh: 大寒登場，我宣布棉被升格為重要生活設施。穿搭還是請看今天的氣溫。

2026-02-04.caption_en: Beginning of Spring: the annual stretching programme is open. First, a preparatory nap.
2026-02-04.caption_zh: 立春了，年度伸懶腰計畫正式啟動。進度：先睡一下。

2026-02-14.caption_en: Valentine's Day: save some kindness for your favourite people and yourself. The cat on the sofa has already collected its share.
2026-02-14.caption_zh: 情人節，把溫柔留給喜歡的人。也留一點給自己，沙發上的貓已經自行領取。

2026-02-16.caption_en: Lunar New Year's Eve: good company, a welcoming table, and no annual performance review for the cat. I'll inspect the empty boxes.
2026-02-16.caption_zh: 除夕團圓，願大家吃得開心、聊得自在。我負責巡視空紙箱，不負責回答年終問題。

2026-02-17.caption_en: Happy Lunar New Year! Wishing you peace and good luck. You keep the red envelopes; I'll take the empty box.
2026-02-17.caption_zh: 新年快樂！祝你平安順心。我不搶紅包，只搶紅包袋旁邊的空盒。

2026-02-18.caption_en: Rain Water is a solar term, not a promise of rain. Check the forecast; a calendar makes a terrible umbrella.
2026-02-18.caption_zh: 今天是雨水，節氣名稱不是降雨保證。出門看預報，別拿日曆當雨傘。

2026-02-28.caption_en: A quiet day to remember history, value peace, and care for the people around us.
2026-02-28.caption_zh: 今天留一點安靜，記得歷史、珍惜和平，也好好照顧身邊的人。

2026-03-03.caption_en: Lantern Festival: wishing you a full heart. The tangyuan are yours, the empty box is mine. Clear responsibilities.
2026-03-03.caption_zh: 元宵節，祝你日子圓圓滿滿。湯圓留給你，紙箱留給我，分工很清楚。

2026-03-05.caption_en: Awakening of Insects: the calendar calls for waking up. I've stretched; full consciousness is still under review.
2026-03-05.caption_zh: 驚蟄到了，日曆提醒萬物甦醒。我已經伸過懶腰，醒來這件事再議。

2026-03-08.caption_en: International Women's Day: here's to choosing your own life. Rest needn't wait for an empty to-do list. The cat has expertise.
2026-03-08.caption_zh: 婦女節，願你能選擇自己想過的生活。休息不用先完成全部待辦，這點貓很有經驗。

2026-03-14.caption_en: White Day: accept the kindness that comes your way. Save some for yourself too; cats mastered that early.
2026-03-14.caption_zh: 白色情人節，收到溫柔就好好收下。沒收到也別忘了疼自己，貓早就學會了。

2026-03-20.caption_en: Spring Equinox is about balance. My version: a nap on the left, then one on the right.
2026-03-20.caption_zh: 春分講究平衡。我的版本是左邊躺一下，右邊也不能漏掉。

2026-04-01.caption_en: April Fools' Day: I won't nap today. Yes, that's the joke. The weather numbers are still serious.
2026-04-01.caption_zh: 愚人節，我說今天不睡午覺。你笑了吧？天氣數字照常認真報，只有貓在鬧。

2026-04-04.caption_en: Children's Day: room to play, ask questions, and be heard. Grown-ups may let their playful side out too.
2026-04-04.caption_zh: 兒童節，祝小朋友有得玩、有得問，也有人好好聽。大人今天也可以把玩心放出來透透氣。

2026-04-05.caption_en: Qingming: a gentle moment for remembrance. Check the weather and your route when visiting family or paying respects.
2026-04-05.caption_zh: 清明，把思念輕輕留在心裡。出門祭祖或探親，記得留意路況與天氣。

2026-04-20.caption_en: Grain Rain marks spring's handover. My seasonal transitions are simpler: find a different nap spot.
2026-04-20.caption_zh: 穀雨到了，春天準備交班。貓的四季交班比較簡單：換個地方睡。

2026-04-22.caption_en: Earth Day: care for our shared home. I'll start by reusing this box until you try to recycle it.
2026-04-22.caption_zh: 地球日，珍惜我們共同的家。我先從愛惜紙箱做起，重複使用到你想回收為止。

2026-05-01.caption_en: Labour Day: thank you for all the work you do. Make room for rest; the cat has extensive experience.
2026-05-01.caption_zh: 勞動節，謝謝每一份努力，也別忘了休息。貓的休息資歷很深，歡迎參考。

2026-05-05.caption_en: Beginning of Summer: the calendar changes mode. Let the temperature decide the air conditioning, not my dramatic flopping.
2026-05-05.caption_zh: 立夏，日曆進入夏季模式。冷氣要不要開，請看溫度，不要看我演得多累。

2026-05-10.caption_en: Mother's Day: thank you for the everyday care. Don't just suggest a break; take over a chore. The cat will supervise.
2026-05-10.caption_zh: 母親節，謝謝那些被當成理所當然的小事。今天別只說『妳休息』，也把家事接過去。貓會監工。

2026-05-21.caption_en: Grain Buds: life needn't be full to the brim. Fewer tasks, fewer appointments. The food bowl is still under negotiation.
2026-05-21.caption_zh: 小滿提醒我們，不必事事全滿。待辦不用滿，行程不用滿，飯碗這題我保留意見。

2026-06-05.caption_en: Grain in Ear: plant a small intention and take a small step. Don't just plant yourself on the sofa like me.
2026-06-05.caption_zh: 芒種，適合把想做的事種下去。先做一小步，別像我只把自己種在沙發裡。

2026-06-19.caption_en: Dragon Boat Festival: enjoy your zongzi; I'll inspect the packaging. Keep your schedule less tightly packed than lunch.
2026-06-19.caption_zh: 端午節，粽子你吃，包裝我看。祝你過節開心，別讓行程塞得比粽子還滿。

2026-06-21.caption_en: Summer Solstice brings long Northern Hemisphere days. You don't have to fill every extra moment with work. Stretching is an option.
2026-06-21.caption_zh: 夏至，北半球白晝很長。長出來的時間不用全拿來忙，也可以拿來伸個懶腰。

2026-07-07.caption_en: Minor Heat: the name says 'minor', but your plans should still follow the forecast. Drink water; don't become a sun-dried cat.
2026-07-07.caption_zh: 小暑登場，名字有個『小』，不代表天氣可以小看。補水看預報，別把自己曬成貓乾。

2026-07-23.caption_en: Major Heat is on the calendar. Check the temperature and carry water. My year-round fur coat has a very poor returns policy.
2026-07-23.caption_zh: 大暑到了，出門記得看溫度、帶水。我的毛外套全年不能退貨，正在努力接受現實。

2026-08-07.caption_en: Beginning of Autumn: the calendar changes first. Your wardrobe can wait for the temperature's opinion.
2026-08-07.caption_zh: 立秋，日曆先換季。衣櫃不用急著跟進，今天穿什麼還是問溫度。

2026-08-08.caption_en: Happy Taiwan Father's Day! Let Dad choose the plan. Sofa space is negotiable, pending the cat's approval.
2026-08-08.caption_zh: 父親節快樂！今天讓爸爸選一下想做的事。沙發位置可以商量，但要先問貓。

2026-08-19.caption_en: Qixi: tell someone you miss them. I express affection more subtly, by sitting on your keyboard.
2026-08-19.caption_zh: 七夕，想念的人可以說聲想你。我表達愛的方式比較含蓄：坐在你的鍵盤上。

2026-08-23.caption_en: End of Heat: the calendar has filed the paperwork. Check today's forecast to see whether the temperature signed it.
2026-08-23.caption_zh: 處暑，日曆說暑氣準備退場。氣溫有沒有同意，請看今天預報。

2026-08-27.caption_en: Ghost Festival: respect the traditions, and take care wherever you're going. Taipei Cat keeps today's weather company quietly.
2026-08-27.caption_zh: 中元節，尊重習俗，也祝大家出入平安。台北貓今天陪你安安靜靜看天氣。

2026-09-07.caption_en: White Dew marks another seasonal step. Check the forecast for layers; the cat's jumper is permanently attached.
2026-09-07.caption_zh: 白露，季節走到新的刻度。外套要不要帶看預報，貓已經自備毛衣。

2026-09-23.note_en: Day and night in balance. A gentler season begins.
2026-09-23.caption_en: Autumn Equinox: balance is the theme. Work and sleep are still negotiating; sleep has the stronger position.
2026-09-23.caption_zh: 秋分，日夜談平衡。我的工作與睡眠還沒談攏，睡眠目前佔上風。

2026-09-25.caption_en: Mid-Autumn Festival: wishing you happy company. You get the mooncakes, I get the box. Everybody wins.
2026-09-25.caption_zh: 中秋節，祝你團圓開心。月餅你吃，盒子我住，這才是雙贏。

2026-09-28.name_zh: 教師節／孔子誕辰紀念日
2026-09-28.caption_en: Teachers' Day: thank you for explaining things until they click. Today's reminder: teachers deserve a proper break too.
2026-09-28.caption_zh: 教師節，謝謝老師把問題講到我們聽懂。今天換我提醒：老師也值得好好休息。

2026-10-08.caption_en: Cold Dew is here. My autumn outfit is still the same fur coat. Please let the temperature style yours.
2026-10-08.caption_zh: 寒露到了，貓的秋裝依然是同一件毛外套。你的穿搭請依氣溫決定，別學我。

2026-10-10.caption_en: Happy National Day! Leave some space in the schedule. Rest counts; the cat's diary is impressively blank.
2026-10-10.caption_zh: 國慶日快樂！行程留點空白，休息也是正事。貓的行程表已經白到快看不到字。

2026-10-18.caption_en: Double Ninth Festival: check in with the older people you love. Walk at your own pace; no need to compete with a climbing cat.
2026-10-18.caption_zh: 重陽節，陪長輩聊聊、問聲近況。要去走走也量力而為，不用跟貓比登高。

2026-10-23.caption_en: Frost's Descent is a solar term, not a Taipei frost forecast. Check the temperature; my fur is not a thermometer.
2026-10-23.caption_zh: 霜降是節氣名，不是台北今天會結霜。要不要加衣，看預報比看我的毛準。

2026-10-25.name_zh: 臺灣光復暨金門古寧頭大捷紀念日
2026-10-25.caption_en: A day to learn about history and appreciate everyday life. Taipei Cat brings a calm weather note.
2026-10-25.caption_zh: 今天留點時間認識歷史，也珍惜眼前的日常。台北貓陪你平靜地看今天的天氣。

2026-10-31.caption_en: Halloween costume: a very hungry cat. The performance is so convincing you might think it's real.
2026-10-31.caption_zh: 萬聖節，我的變裝是『很餓的貓』。演技自然到你可能以為是真的。

2026-11-07.caption_en: Beginning of Winter: the calendar switches modes. I've nominated the duvet as colleague of the season.
2026-11-07.caption_zh: 立冬，日曆進入冬季模式。我已提名棉被擔任本季最佳同事。

2026-11-22.caption_en: Minor Snow is a solar term, not a promise of snow in Taipei. My blanket is ready regardless.
2026-11-22.caption_zh: 小雪到了，但台北有沒有雪不是名字說了算。我的棉被倒是已經準備好上場。

2026-11-26.caption_en: Thanksgiving: grateful for the small things that make life better. My list includes you, and the box you haven't thrown away.
2026-11-26.caption_zh: 感恩節，謝謝那些讓生活舒服的小事。貓的感恩名單：有你，還有你沒有收走的紙箱。

2026-12-07.caption_en: Major Snow is a solar term; no need to order snow boots on its name alone. Check the forecast while I check nap locations.
2026-12-07.caption_zh: 大雪是節氣名，別急著找雪靴。台北貓先找好睡的位置，出門穿搭交給預報。

2026-12-22.caption_en: Winter Solstice: enjoy the tangyuan and the company. I'm already sufficiently round; no extra bowl required.
2026-12-22.caption_zh: 冬至，湯圓你吃，團圓我參與。我的形狀已經夠圓，不必再加一碗。

2026-12-24.caption_en: Christmas Eve: wishing you a peaceful night. Unwrap at your leisure; save the box for the cat pretending not to care.
2026-12-24.caption_zh: 平安夜，願今晚安心自在。禮物慢慢拆，空盒請留給旁邊假裝不在意的貓。

2026-12-25.caption_en: Merry Christmas! You got the gift; I got the box. Outstanding work from the packaging department.
2026-12-25.caption_zh: 聖誕快樂！你收到禮物，我收到盒子。包裝部門今年表現優異。

2026-12-31.caption_en: New Year's Eve: you needn't chase every unfinished task to midnight. Give yourself some credit. The cat approves an early night.
2026-12-31.caption_zh: 跨年夜，沒完成的事不必全部追到午夜。先對自己說聲辛苦了，貓批准你提早休息。

morning.opening_zh: 星期五，國慶補假，連假模式直接啟動！
morning.opening_en: Friday is Taiwan's National Day substitute holiday. Long-weekend mode: on!
morning.caption_zh: 今天國慶補假，不用等下班，連假已經開始。本貓取消通勤，改走飯碗到沙發路線。放假的慢慢來，仍要上班的朋友辛苦了，貓貓陪你看天氣。
morning.caption_en: It's the National Day substitute holiday: the long weekend starts now. I've replaced my commute with a bowl-to-sofa route. Take your time if you're off; if you're working, this cat is keeping you company.
morning.closing_zh: 出遊先看天氣，宅家也很合理。今天的鬧鐘，貓批准休假。🐾
morning.closing_en: Check the forecast before heading out. Staying home is a fine plan too; the alarm has the day off. 🐾

evening.opening_zh: 星期五晚班，國慶連假第一天，貓貓陪你繼續放鬆。
evening.opening_en: Friday evening: day one of Taiwan's National Day long weekend. Keep relaxing with the cat.
evening.caption_zh: 國慶連假第一天，今天最忙的工作是決定下一餐吃什麼。本貓的假期進度：吃飽、躺好、再吃一點。出遊的慢慢玩，今天值班的朋友也別忘了休息。
evening.caption_en: Day one of the National Day long weekend. My busiest task is deciding what to eat next: dinner, sofa, perhaps more dinner. Enjoy your evening out or in; if you're on duty, make room for a break too.
evening.closing_zh: 連假還有兩天，今晚不用急著收心。回家或續攤，先看天氣喵。🐾
evening.closing_en: Two more days of the long weekend ahead. Heading home or staying out? Check the pawcast first. 🐾

morning.safety_zh:
🐾 趁風雨尚未增強，收妥陽台盆栽與易掉落物品，檢查門窗。
🐾 備好飲水、手電筒，手機與行動電源先充電，毛孩糧食也別漏掉。
🐾 風雨期間避免非必要外出；不去海邊觀浪，不到溪邊與山區冒險。必要外出留意路樹、招牌與積水。
🐾 停班停課以政府公告為準；若接獲疏散通知，請配合撤離。
morning.safety_en:
🐾 Before winds strengthen, secure loose balcony items and check doors and windows.
🐾 Prepare drinking water and a torch, charge your phone and power bank, and include pet food.
🐾 Avoid unnecessary trips during severe weather. Stay away from coasts, rivers and mountains; watch for falling objects and flooding if travel is essential.
🐾 Follow official work/school and evacuation announcements.
morning.closing_zh: 我負責喵，你負責平安。曬太陽的約，等風雨過去再赴。💛
morning.closing_en: I'll bring the meows. You stay safe. Our sunny-window date can wait. 💛
morning.opening_zh: 薔琵接近，台北貓切換防颱值班！🐾🌀
morning.opening_en: Champi is approaching: Taipei Cat is on typhoon duty. 🐾
morning.caption_zh: 依 10/22 午間氣象說明，今晚起北台灣雨勢漸趨明顯，10/23 至 24 日清晨須特別留意風雨，北部與宜蘭山區慎防豪雨以上降雨。先把防颱準備做好，別等風雨到門口才開始找手電筒；本貓已先清點罐罐。
morning.caption_en: The Oct 22 midday outlook calls for increasing rain in northern Taiwan tonight. Pay particular attention to wind and rain from Oct 23 to early Oct 24, with a heavy-rain risk in northern and Yilan mountain areas. Prepare before conditions worsen; this cat has already counted the food pouches.

evening.safety_zh:
🐾 趁風雨尚未增強，收妥陽台盆栽與易掉落物品，檢查門窗。
🐾 備好飲水、手電筒，手機與行動電源先充電，毛孩糧食也別漏掉。
🐾 風雨期間避免非必要外出；不去海邊觀浪，不到溪邊與山區冒險。必要外出留意路樹、招牌與積水。
🐾 停班停課以政府公告為準；若接獲疏散通知，請配合撤離。

🐾 Prepare drinking water and a torch, charge your phone and power bank, and include pet food.
🐾 Avoid unnecessary trips during severe weather. Stay away from coasts, rivers and mountains; watch for falling objects and flooding if travel is essential.
🐾 Follow official work/school and evacuation announcements.
evening.closing_zh: 我負責喵，你負責平安。曬太陽的約，等風雨過去再赴。💛
evening.closing_en: I'll bring the meows. You stay safe. Our sunny-window date can wait. 💛
evening.opening_zh: 今晚不催喵友出門，先催大家做好防颱。🐾🌀
evening.opening_en: Tonight's reminder: typhoon preparations before any plans out. 🐾
evening.caption_zh: 薔琵颱風接近。依 10/22 午間預報，今晚起北台灣降雨漸趨明顯，10/23 至 24 日清晨須留意風雨，北部與宜蘭山區防豪雨以上降雨。請趁安全時把陽台收好、用品備齊；已經起風下雨，就別冒險出去搬東西。本貓今晚值班顧消息，也顧著叫你平安回家。
evening.caption_en: Champi is approaching. The Oct 22 midday outlook indicates increasing rain in northern Taiwan tonight, with wind and rain a concern from Oct 23 to early Oct 24 and heavy rain possible in northern and Yilan mountain areas. Secure belongings while it is safe; don't go outside to retrieve them once conditions become dangerous. This cat is on safety-reminder duty tonight.

morning.safety_zh:
🐾 趁風雨尚未增強，收妥陽台盆栽與易掉落物品，檢查門窗。
🐾 備好飲水、手電筒，手機與行動電源先充電，毛孩糧食也別漏掉。

🐾 停班停課以政府公告為準；若接獲疏散通知，請配合撤離。

🐾 Before winds strengthen, secure loose balcony items and check doors and windows.
🐾 Prepare drinking water and a torch, charge your phone and power bank, and include pet food.
🐾 Avoid unnecessary trips during severe weather. Stay away from coasts, rivers and mountains; watch for falling objects and flooding if travel is essential.

morning.closing_zh: 我負責喵，你負責平安。曬太陽的約，等風雨過去再赴。💛
morning.closing_en: I'll bring the meows. You stay safe. Our sunny-window date can wait. 💛
morning.opening_zh: 星期五先不開週末模式，台北貓今天顧大家平安。🐾🌀
morning.opening_en: Friday's weekend mode can wait: Taipei Cat is on safety duty. 🐾
morning.caption_zh: 依 10/22 午間預報，10/23 至 24 日清晨是須特別留意薔琵風雨的時段，北部與宜蘭山區有豪雨以上降雨風險。這是前一日的預報提醒，颱風位置、強度與警戒範圍請務必查看氣象署最新更新。別因眼前暫時風雨不大就鬆懈；今天能少跑一趟，就少跑一趟。貓掌不挑戰風雨，喵友也別逞強。
morning.caption_en: The Oct 22 midday outlook highlighted Oct 23 to early Oct 24 for particular attention to Champi's wind and rain, including heavy-rain risk in northern and Yilan mountain areas. This is the previous day's outlook: check CWA for the latest position, intensity and warning areas. A temporary lull does not mean the danger has passed. Avoid unnecessary trips; neither paws nor people need to test the storm.

evening.safety_zh:
🐾 趁風雨尚未增強，收妥陽台盆栽與易掉落物品，檢查門窗。
🐾 備好飲水、手電筒，手機與行動電源先充電，毛孩糧食也別漏掉。
🐾 風雨期間避免非必要外出；不去海邊觀浪，不到溪邊與山區冒險。必要外出留意路樹、招牌與積水。
🐾 停班停課以政府公告為準；若接獲疏散通知，請配合撤離。
evening.safety_en:
🐾 Before winds strengthen, secure loose balcony items and check doors and windows.
🐾 Prepare drinking water and a torch, charge your phone and power bank, and include pet food.
🐾 Avoid unnecessary trips during severe weather. Stay away from coasts, rivers and mountains; watch for falling objects and flooding if travel is essential.
🐾 Follow official work/school and evacuation announcements.
evening.closing_zh: 我負責喵，你負責平安。曬太陽的約，等風雨過去再赴。💛
evening.closing_en: I'll bring the meows. You stay safe. Our sunny-window date can wait. 💛
evening.opening_zh: 週五晚班繼續防颱，今晚的約先留給平安。🐾🌀
evening.opening_en: Friday evening's priority is safety, with typhoon updates still on duty. 🐾
evening.caption_zh: 依 10/22 午間預報，10/23 晚間至 24 日清晨仍在須留意風雨的時段；實際影響請查看氣象署最新警報與風雨預報，不能把這份前一日預報當作目前實況。風雨還沒穩定，就先不安排非必要外出，也別急著去海邊、溪邊或山區。本貓可以等罐罐，大家也可以等天氣穩定再出門。
evening.caption_en: The Oct 22 midday outlook still placed the evening of Oct 23 to early Oct 24 within the period needing attention to wind and rain. Check current CWA warnings and forecasts; yesterday's outlook is not a live observation. Postpone unnecessary trips until conditions are safe, and stay away from the coast, rivers and mountains. If this cat can wait for treats, the outing can wait too.
